title: Nihongo con Teppei — 趣味について (About Hobbies)
description: From Nihongo con Teppei — the main series for intermediate learners where Teppei talks freely about topics in natural Japanese. This episode covers talking about hobbies, how to explain what you enjoy doing, and the difference between 好き, 得意, and よくやる. Natural but accessible N4 pace.
